subject: general
question: What is the average temperature of Chennai in cold season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**24o - 25o Celsius.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Winter from December till the end of February is the best season for Chennai.
 
• The weather during this time is very pleasant with an average minimum recording close to 21o C.
 
• The winter season is never very severe.
 
• The lowest temperature ever recorded is 13oC, during the month of January.
 
• So, the average temperature for winter is 24o C to 25o C.
